cases.title: Scenario matrix row for voluntary logout across authenticated roles
preconditions: Testing-plan §12 Authentication lifecycle row applies (FR-36, FR-38; BR-05, BR-24; AC-06, AC-26).
Role-matrix fixture provides Student, Lecturer, and AcademicAdmin accounts with valid credentials.
steps: Authenticate each role via POST /v1/auth/login and confirm GET /v1/me returns HTTP 200.
Invoke POST /v1/auth/logout with the issued bearer token.
Discard client-held credentials per BR-24.
Call GET /v1/me without Authorization and attempt one role-appropriate protected endpoint per role.
cases.expected: Logout returns HTTP 200 with data.loggedOut true per API §4.1; subsequent requests without a new login return 401 Unauthenticated and protected routes require re-authentication per AC-26.

cases.title: M01 identity module acknowledges logout without mutating attendance data
preconditions: Real database transaction is enabled for M01 Identity and Access.
Authenticated Lecturer actor has an open session roster context available.
steps: Resolve authenticated actor via M01 middleware with valid bearer token.
Invoke POST /v1/auth/logout through the auth route handler.
Query attendance_records and audit_logs for unexpected writes tied to logout.
Repeat GET /v1/me through authenticate middleware after client token discard simulation.
cases.expected: Logout handler returns success envelope only; no attendance or roster mutations occur; authenticate middleware rejects cleared session with Unauthenticated per BR-24.

cases.title: HTTP contract for POST /v1/auth/logout then protected GET /v1/me rejection
preconditions: Student account exists; client holds a valid accessToken from POST /v1/auth/login.
steps: Send POST /v1/auth/logout with Authorization Bearer accessToken.
Assert HTTP 200 and data.loggedOut is true.
Clear client Authorization header to simulate credential discard.
Send GET /v1/me without Authorization.
cases.expected: Logout returns HTTP 200 with standard envelope; subsequent GET /v1/me returns HTTP 401 with error.code Unauthenticated per API §4.1 and BR-24.

cases.title: HTTP contract for unauthenticated POST /v1/auth/logout rejection
preconditions: No bearer token is held by the test client.
steps: Send POST /v1/auth/logout without Authorization header.
Inspect HTTP status and response envelope error.code.
cases.expected: API returns HTTP 401 with error.code Unauthenticated; no loggedOut success payload is returned without authentication.

cases.title: FLOW-15 primary logout flow for Lecturer then blocked roster access
preconditions: Lecturer is authenticated with valid bearer token.
Assigned Open session exists for post-logout denial check.
steps: Execute FLOW-15 logout: POST /v1/auth/logout, clear client credentials, redirect target is PG-01.
Attempt GET /v1/class-sessions/{sessionId}/attendance without re-login.
Re-authenticate Lecturer and confirm roster access restores.
cases.expected: Voluntary logout clears session context; attendance roster API returns 401 until Lecturer logs in again; no cross-session data leakage after logout per AC-26.

cases.title: Staff SidebarNav Đăng xuất control ends session and returns to PG-01
preconditions: Lecturer is logged in on desktop Chromium at PG-04 /lecturer/sessions.
SidebarNav renders per design-system/sidebars.md with logout footer control.
steps: Locate Đăng xuất control in sidebar footer separated from primary nav items.
Activate logout control and observe navigation to PG-01 without returnUrl query param.
Attempt direct navigation to /lecturer/sessions and observe login redirect.
Verify no privileged roster or session data remains visible in DOM after logout.
cases.expected: FLOW-15 staff logout is reachable from every authenticated staff page; PG-01 loads after logout; protected lecturer routes redirect to login per FR-38 and AC-26.

cases.title: Student mobile shell logout clears check-in gate and blocks protected history route
preconditions: Student is authenticated at PG-02 or PG-03 on mobile viewport (375px).
Student shell exposes logout in header or account menu per LAY-01.
steps: Activate student logout control.
Confirm navigation to PG-01 and cleared access token / student auth flag.
Navigate to /me/attendance and observe login redirect.
Re-login and confirm attendance history restores for self scope only.
cases.expected: Student logout follows FLOW-15; FR-15 auth gate re-applies after logout; /me/attendance requires fresh login without exposing prior session data per AC-26.
